stages.name: Elementary school (K–5)
stages.blurb: Numbers, reading and writing, science and the world around us, plus first steps in computational thinking and Python, learned with a grown-up close by.

stages.name: Middle school (6–8)
stages.blurb: Ratios to algebra, reading and writing, life, physical and earth science, history, and programming in Python.

stages.name: High school (9–12)
stages.blurb: Algebra through calculus and statistics, biology, chemistry and physics, English and history, and Python for data and simulation.

stages.name: College neuroscience and cognitive science degree
stages.blurb: Biology, chemistry, physics and the mathematics of data; the brain from molecules and cells to neural systems; perception, learning, memory, emotion, language and thought; statistics, neural data analysis, computational neuroscience, cognitive modeling and neuroimaging; philosophy of mind, machine learning and neuroethics.

stages.name: Graduate study and research in neuroscience
stages.blurb: Theoretical neuroscience, circuits and systems methods, the science of consciousness, brains and machines, research methods and reproducibility, and a research apprenticeship with qualifying-exam preparation.
